summary: DEFSEC Technologies, a TSXV/NASDAQ-listed Canadian defence software issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit 99.1 news release dated September 14, 2026, announcing routine board composition changes effective as it enters FY2027. George Weber, former Chairman of Calian Group (TSX: CGY), joins as Vice-Chairman, replacing retiring director Paul Fortin; David Luxton transitions from Executive Chairman to Non-Executive Chairman and Sean Homuth remains President and CEO. The release also notes participation in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, September 14-16. No stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, or transaction mechanics disclosed; no special-situation event.
